comment: A newly created envelope is FERMEE (closed) and not yet paired to a physical
crossing — pairing/EMBARQUEMENT/DEBARQUEMENT happen later, out of band, and
arrive as an ENV_NOT01 passage notification the ELO API pushes rather than
returns here (this stub set has nothing that produces one; nothing in the
solution consumes ENV_NOT01 yet either — see src/EDI.ELO/README.md).
The jeton/numeroDossier values are fixed, regex-valid samples (see the
patterns on Enveloppe.Jeton/NumeroDossier in the spec) rather than echoes of
the request, since the real API mints both server-side.
To rehearse the 400 path, copy this file, change response.status to 400 and
the jsonBody to the ENV_CRE03 shape ({ informationsErreur: { statut,
libelleErreur } }), then give it a higher priority and a narrower matcher.
